entries.action: Read the Locations step, then add Astro-T7/Captures with the native picker and a display name, and a second Captures folder.
entries.expect: Captures is required and the optional roles are named. Each row shows the path, role, access state, and Online.
entries.negative: Adding a folder starts no indexing and creates, renames, moves, or deletes no file. No workspace root, application, or account is requested.

entries.action: Add a calibration location and leave Results unset.
entries.expect: Onboarding continues and Results reads not set.
entries.negative: The unset role is not shown as an error or a failed setup.

entries.spec: 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-03, LIB-FR-04, LIB-FR-05, LIB-FR-06; D01, D11, D15
entries.action: Start indexing, inspect sessions and association evidence, confirm Targets and equipment, and rescan with an unreadable session folder.
entries.expect: Seven homogeneous sessions appear with the evidence behind each association. Needs review appears where evidence is missing or conflicts. Confirmations are catalog-only.
entries.negative: No session mixes channels, no OBJECT label alone assigns a Target, source headers stay byte-identical, and unreadable files never read Missing.

entries.action: Browse while indexing runs, recover a denied location with Retry, and take a location offline.
entries.expect: Totals are provisional and name their locations. The denied row offers Choose folder again and Retry. The offline location keeps its last-observed metadata.
entries.negative: No total implies unscanned data. Offline or denied files are not reported Missing or empty.

entries.action: Open NGC 7000 from Target search.
entries.expect: Captured, usable, and Unreviewed integration show per channel. Availability is a separate state, and the offline contribution reads Offline.
entries.negative: The offline contribution is not offered as an available input.

entries.action: Create Project NGC 7000 HOO, confirm its Target framing, link sessions explicitly, and set equipment and a checklist; later, meet one item.
entries.expect: Progress shows captured and library-usable totals separately. The exposure check shows evidence, not hours. A met item leaves the Project open.
entries.negative: Creating the Project changes no file, View, or quality state. Sessions are never linked by proximity or name.

entries.action: Inspect the capture sites, then switch the planning site.
entries.expect: Each session keeps its own capture site, and visibility recalculates for the chosen site and time zone.
entries.negative: Membership and capture sites do not change, and notifications stay disabled.

entries.action: Create a View from the Project; separately, create a standalone View from Sessions.
entries.expect: The workspace opens with Project context even though the checklist is unmet. The standalone View has no Project.
entries.negative: Creating a View creates no folder on disk and changes no quality state.

entries.action: Move among the workspace areas, toggle Sky coverage, and name the View.
entries.expect: All areas share one selection, and the name and Project show while the profile is unset.
entries.negative: No wizard gates movement between areas.

entries.action: Read the geometric suggestions.
entries.expect: Only sessions with confirmed framing, confirmed Project equipment, pointing, orientation, and overlap are preselected, including the one whose label differs. Each candidate shows its evidence.
entries.negative: Preselection merges no sessions and rewrites no headers or Targets. Angular separation alone qualifies no session.

entries.action: Inspect the FOV, pointing-only, and Position unknown evidence, then include those sessions manually.
entries.expect: FOV from confirmed equipment lists its inputs. Pointing-only and unknown sessions are selectable only by a manual check.
entries.negative: Unknown geometry never shows a distance of 0, and no OBJECT label supplies coordinates.

entries.action: Apply the channel, Missing OBJECT, and quality-state filters, open the expanded controls, and sort by sky distance.
entries.expect: Filter chips, match counts, and the hidden-selected count show. Measurement columns read Not measured.
entries.negative: Filters change no selected IDs, start no measurement, and change no quality state.

entries.action: Show the selection, browse, save explicitly, clear a standalone draft, and see an Unusable frame start excluded.
entries.expect: Available Unreviewed and Usable frames are included (214 / 17h 50m), and Unusable frames start visibly excluded. The selection survives sort, paging, and the sky toggle. Save View commits a revision.
entries.negative: Inclusion applies no quality action. Clearing one draft changes no other View.

entries.action: Select the offline session, then remove it explicitly.
entries.expect: It reads Offline with unverified counts, and its frames are named unresolved members.
entries.negative: An offline source is never dropped silently or counted as verified.

entries.spec: 067-frame-review PIX-FR-01, PIX-FR-06, PIX-AC-01, PIX-AC-10; 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-09, LIB-AC-14; 065-project-goals PRJ-FR-04; D19
entries.action: Open Review frames, cancel measurement, and reopen. Replace a reviewed frame's bytes in place, rescan and reopen, then restore the reviewed bytes.
entries.expect: Pending frames and progress show. After Cancel, unfinished frames read Not measured. Cached values reappear and missing ones resume. The replaced frame reads ChangedContent outside usable totals and Project progress and is measured again; restored bytes make it Usable again.
entries.negative: Cancel discards no selection or exclusion. Cached or imported values for other bytes never read valid, and no quality decision is recorded.

entries.action: Select frames from a row and from the plot. Zoom, pan, compare regions, step between frames, and apply and remove a stretch.
entries.expect: The selection is highlighted in the list, plot, and preview. Metadata, source, and units appear on disclosure.
entries.negative: Stretch changes no measured value or source byte.

entries.action: Enable Stars and inspect a fitted star and a saturated star.
entries.expect: Fit details and cutouts show, with distinct HFR and FWHM labels and units. The saturated star reads failed fit with a warning.
entries.negative: No width number is shown for a failed fit.

entries.action: Exclude six 30 Sep frames, restore and re-exclude one, and read the totals.
entries.expect: The 30 Sep row reads 42 of 48 and the View reads 208 / 17h 20m (Ha 111 / 9h 15m, OIII 97 / 8h 05m).
entries.negative: The files stay on disk. Library quality, Target usable totals, other Views, and the Project are unchanged.

entries.action: Mark the included frames usable with the named scope, mark one frame unusable in the library, and reject another for the Project.
entries.expect: Each confirmation names its scope. Only the confirmed frames change state, and Target usable integration rises by the usable total.
entries.negative: The Project rejection changes no library total, and no action changes View membership.

entries.action: Import a SubframeSelector CSV, confirm the mapping, and inspect the unresolved rows.
entries.expect: Matched, unmatched, and ambiguous rows are listed. Imported values show with provenance next to native values.
entries.negative: No native value is replaced and no exclusion or quality change is imported. A column without units is not relabeled as FWHM or HFR.

entries.action: Open calibration, read Why this match, accept the suggestions explicitly, and inspect the raw flat handoff.
entries.expect: Suggestions are grouped and listed separately from accepted assignments. The criteria are listed. Raw flats go to the application to build its own masters.
entries.negative: Nothing is accepted implicitly, no temperature tolerance is applied unless shown, and no master is written.

entries.action: Find the unresolved 24 Sep flat, record a scoped exception with a reason, and check another View.
entries.expect: The exception keeps the unknown criterion and the reason, and another View shows no exception.
entries.negative: The flat set's evidence is unchanged and the exception does not make it universally compatible.

entries.action: Choose the Siril profile; separately, try Open in....
entries.expect: The profile shows its capability evidence. Open in... reads unverified, blocks Linked and Direct source, and offers Copy or Clone.
entries.negative: No unverified capability is claimed, there is no claim that renaming overrides headers, and nothing is launched.

entries.action: Compare the catalog and header values for 28 Sep, accept the source value in the main View, and patch copies in the check View.
entries.expect: The effective handoff value is named, and only the isolated copies carry the patched value.
entries.negative: No correction is claimed as delivered while the tool reads the original. Originals are byte-identical.

entries.action: Read the input modes, try Direct source, and confirm a hardlink choice.
entries.expect: Each mode states its semantics and storage. Direct source passes exact paths or refuses an overinclusive folder. The hardlink limits are named.
entries.negative: No overinclusive handoff is accepted, and the link type does not change without confirmation.

entries.action: Choose a colliding folder, lose the parent volume, and choose Work/Processing.
entries.expect: The collision and the unavailable parent each prompt another choice. The final path is shown.
entries.negative: Unrelated content is untouched and no drive is substituted silently.

entries.action: Keep View/output, and in the check View override the output parent.
entries.expect: The default and a View-specific subfolder under the override are recorded.
entries.negative: The override parent is never used directly as the output folder.

entries.action: Review preparation, confirm the exact membership, and meet a destination without links.
entries.expect: The full review content and checks show, and Clone, Copy, and Direct alternatives appear with footprints.
entries.negative: Nothing is written before Prepare, and no omitted or unaccepted input is counted. A link plan never becomes a copy silently.

entries.action: Prepare, prepare with three blocked inputs while trying Mark complete, Retry while one source changes after its snapshot, then restore it and Retry.
entries.expect: Prepared appears only when the entries match the membership and their source snapshots. Partial reads 53/3, then 55/1 with drift named. Retry completes the journaled entries to 56.
entries.negative: An acknowledgment is not success and no verified Open is offered on Partial. Complete is refused while preparation runs. A drifted item never reads Prepared. Sources are untouched.

entries.action: Open with a missing executable, open after a linked input changed in place, then restore it, open Siril and quit it.
entries.expect: Choose application and Reveal View are offered. A changed entry refuses the launch and is named. Open re-verifies every entry before launching, and the launch is recorded separately from processing.
entries.negative: The View stays Prepared, Siril never launches on changed bytes, and quitting Siril does not mark it Complete.

entries.spec: 066-view-selection VSEL-FR-08, VSEL-FR-12, VSEL-AC-06, VSEL-AC-15; 064-library-inventory LIB-FR-08, LIB-AC-15; 069-application-handoff PREP-FR-11; D02, D08, D09, D16, D19
entries.action: Index new arrivals, one session also copied to a second Captures location, make a member unreadable, Refresh selection, keep the View unchanged, then accept one addition, decline one, and save. Finally change one copy of a copied frame and rescan.
entries.expect: The copied session's frames count once and name both copies. Additions show with reasons, manual inclusions and exclusions stay recorded, and the unreadable member reads Unavailable. The accepted change becomes a proposed revision that needs review. A changed copy reads as conflicting copies.
entries.negative: Membership never changes without approval, and no copied frame enters it twice. The prepared revision and the inputs Siril reads stay identical. A conflicting copy is not counted twice or substituted.

entries.action: Open Results for the View.
entries.expect: Typed candidates with availability show. A growing file reads Pending, and intermediates are listed separately.
entries.negative: Nothing is auto-accepted or claimed to come from the full selection.

entries.action: Attach a TIFF saved elsewhere as a Final image.
entries.expect: The lineage reads User-linked.
entries.negative: The lineage is never shown as Tool-recorded without tool evidence.

entries.action: Inspect three products, change one before accepting, then inspect it again and accept it.
entries.expect: They appear on the View, Project, and Target and read Keep, each with the SHA-256 recorded at acceptance. A product changed since inspection is refused until inspected again.
entries.negative: Acceptance upgrades no lineage, claims no use of all frames, and never records bytes that were not inspected.

entries.spec: 070-results-reuse RES-FR-04, RES-FR-05, RES-AC-04, RES-AC-05, RES-AC-09; D04
entries.action: Create View from results, choose a product-capable profile, prepare and open the View, then replace a product's bytes with its size and mtime preserved and restore them.
entries.expect: Two product inputs with their originating View. Unsupported product kinds are refused by name. The rehash flags the replaced product as drifted for review; restored bytes make it available again.
entries.negative: No raw integration is added and nothing is converted, combined, or replaced silently. Equal stats never stand in for content, and a drifted product is not offered for reuse or re-accepted.

entries.spec: 068-calibration-inputs CAL-FR-06, CAL-FR-07, CAL-FR-08, CAL-AC-04, CAL-AC-05, CAL-AC-07, CAL-AC-08, CAL-AC-09, CAL-AC-10; D05, D13, D19
entries.action: See the detected master, meet an occupied destination path, change the master after review and again before registration, adopt it into a durable calibration destination, then change and restore the adopted copy.
entries.expect: The occupied path is refused, and both source changes block adoption with drift named. The master is registered with provenance only after its copy and source match the reviewed digest, then appears as a suggestion awaiting acceptance. A changed adopted copy reads drifted until its bytes return.
entries.negative: It is never preselected before adoption, the occupying file is unchanged, no copy of changed or unreviewed bytes is registered, its generated source is not removed, and a drifted master is never suggested or accepted.

entries.action: Mark Complete on a View without a Result and on the main View, then try edits on the Complete View.
entries.expect: Complete is recorded and Clean up View is offered separately. Membership edits need an explicit Reopen; notes can be edited.
entries.negative: Completion removes nothing and claims no external success. Complete is refused while a PlateVault operation is running. Complete is refused only while a running PlateVault mutation affects this View; notes, Result acceptance, reviewed cleanup and archive/filing repair do not reopen it.

entries.action: Open Clean up View and select a protected product.
entries.expect: Only recognized intermediates and temporary files are preselected. Keep holds products and masters. A protected selection names its dependent View.
entries.negative: No original is a candidate and the defaults never cover the whole directory.

entries.action: Inspect groups, deselect a file, select the prepared inputs, and leave the unknown file.
entries.expect: Path, role, references, retained-original evidence, and bytes show for each file.
entries.negative: Link sizes are not promised as reclaimed bytes, and Keep stays unselected.

entries.action: Review cleanup, then remove a symlink View's prepared links and a verified duplicate whose kept copy changes after review, and remove the duplicate again after a fresh review.
entries.expect: The exact entries show with Send to OS Trash, movable and blocked counts per location, and a last-copy hardlink blocked. Duplicate removal names the verified copy kept and waits until that copy matches its review again.
entries.negative: Nothing with stale identity, drift, missing proof, an unavailable source, or ambiguous ownership is approved. No symlink target or target directory is followed.

entries.action: Send to Trash after one selected intermediate changes, put one file back, and try a location without Trash.
entries.expect: Per-item outcomes and a partial summary show, naming the changed intermediate as blocked. The removed entries are in the OS Trash. The unsupported location offers Keep files and Reveal location.
entries.negative: Link targets are not followed, protected files and changed entries are unchanged, and no permanent-delete fallback exists.

entries.spec: 071-storage-custody STO-FR-06, STO-FR-07, STO-FR-08, STO-AC-05, STO-AC-14; D06, D09, D11; D09
entries.action: Plan an archive, meet an impostor volume, choose the reference mode, approve, interrupt, retry, change one source before retirement, repair a blocked reference, resolve the drift, and unplug the archive later.
entries.expect: Per-item journaled phases. Sources are retired only after destination and reference verification while they still match their snapshots. Fixed membership; archived inputs read Offline.
entries.negative: No source is retired on failure, uncertainty or drift, and drift retains both versions. Hardlinks are not converted implicitly. Retry does not infer from filenames, and Open never omits unavailable inputs.

entries.action: Plan windows, switch site, try reminders without a default site, set the default and lead time, deny then grant permission, receive one reminder, restart inside its lead time, and export and re-check the .ics.
entries.expect: Windows name their site and time zone. Reminders only after opt-in, naming Backyard. Visible denial with Settings and Retry. The delivered reminder stays recorded as delivered after restart. The .ics holds exactly the selected windows.
entries.negative: No weather or readiness claims, no reminder for the second site, no repeat delivery of a delivered identity, no indexing, no provider account, and the saved .ics never changes.

entries.spec: 071-storage-custody STO-FR-09, STO-AC-06, STO-AC-15; D06, D14, D19; D09
entries.action: Propose filing, meet a collision, revise the plan, approve after one source changes, file it once restored, verify, and interrupt a cross-volume filing.
entries.expect: Every relative path is previewed with its original basename. Only the displayed operations run, and a source changed since review is blocked until it matches again. Hashes verify, and references report outcomes.
entries.negative: Nothing is overwritten, merged, or patched. A source is kept after failed verification, and membership is unchanged.
